name: lv_display_get_vertical_resolution

provenance.source: Exact .139 lv_display decompilation; falls back to the default display at *0x200bd200 when passed 0.

notes: Returns the vertical resolution. The raw fields at display+0 and display+4 are NOT fixed to an axis: when the rotation bit (display+756 & 2) is set this returns display+4 rather than display+0, i.e. it reports the horizontal raw field. _lv_inv_area clips with these accessors, so any code comparing an invalidated area against the screen size must use them too rather than reading the raw fields. Device probe pending.
